registerNotMeasured: Not measured. This file is a cognate record, not a register pass: there is no scripts/l10n/detectors/pt.js and nothing here measured the formal/informal register of the pt bundle, so selfcheck must not report a register verdict for pt.
scopeNote: COGNATE RECORD for pt. Every value in l10n/pt.json that was byte-identical to the English source has been reviewed one by one: each is either recorded below with a written reason, or was replaced by a real translation in the same pass. The list is therefore closed - a NEW identical value in pt means a new judgement, not an existing licence.

cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.Avatar: International term, spelled and used identically in Portuguese.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR's own object name; used untranslated in Portuguese SOLR documentation.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR's object name plus a colon; nothing translatable.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym (Data Subject Access Request); used untranslated in Portuguese privacy practice.
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name; kept untranslated in every finished locale.
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.IBANs: Acronym; the Portuguese plural is written 'IBANs'.
cognates.ID:: Acronym plus a colon; Portuguese puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Id: The same acronym in the casing the source uses.
cognates.Linear: Same spelling and meaning in Portuguese (linear).
cognates.Local: Same spelling and meaning in Portuguese (local).
cognates.N/A: Not-applicable abbreviation, kept as-is in every locale of this app.
cognates.OpenCorporates: Name of an external data source; a proper noun.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Format name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.OpenRegister: The application's own name; a proper noun.
cognates.Quota: Same spelling and meaning in European Portuguese (a quota).
cognates.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation acronym; used untranslated in Portuguese technical writing.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym; used untranslated in Portuguese technical writing.
cognates.Shards: Search-index term; Portuguese technical writing keeps 'shards'.
cognates.Slug: URL-slug term, kept untranslated in Portuguese CMS and API tooling.
cognates.Total: Same spelling and meaning in Portuguese (o total).
cognates.Total:: Same word plus a colon; Portuguese puts no space before a colon.
cognates.UUID:: Acronym plus a colon; Portuguese puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Url: The same acronym in the casing the source uses.
cognates.Webhook: Established loan; the standard term in Portuguese technical UI language.
cognates.Webhooks: Established loan; the Portuguese plural is also 'Webhooks'.
